item.title: What Could Happen as Cardano Retests Key Descending Trendline
item.description: The current consolidatory momentum has seen Cardano retest a key descending trendline, creating two possible price scenarios. Notably, the recent leg down has pushed Cardano to the neckline resistance from which it broke out, following its early January rally to $0.43.Visit Website

item.title: Cardano Partner Chain Midnight to Power Privacy-Preserving AI for Telegram’s 1 Billion Users
item.description: The Midnight Foundation has partnered with AlphaTON Capital to bring its privacy-focused Cardano sidechain, Midnight, into the TON ecosystem to power Telegram’s super app. This strategic agreement allows Telegram’s Cocoon AI to deploy privacy-preserving AI agents at scale.Visit Website

item.title: XRP Is Quietly Accumulating Across Macro and Micro Timeframes
item.description: A recent technical analysis suggests that XRP long-term price pattern continues to show steady accumulation rather than selling pressure. It argues that XRP’s extended period of sideways movement is not a sign of weakness but a defining feature of a larger bullish setup.Visit Website

item.title: XRP Trades Within Wedge Pattern for a Year: What Needs to Happen for a Breakout?
item.description: XRP has continued to trade within a wedge pattern over the past year, and a possible breakout could emerge when the Bitcoin dominance collapses. The broader crypto market has faced bearish pressure since Q4 2025, losing over $880 billion within this period.Visit Website

item.title: XRP Upside Scenarios if Ripple Becomes Threat to Major Banks
item.description: Ripple's expansion through acquisitions and regulatory progress has changed how most XRP community members see the company. Instead of seeing Ripple as only a blockchain payments firm, several commentators now call it an emerging competitor to traditional banks, especially in treasury services, cross-border payments, and custody.Visit Website

item.title: Those Claiming XRP Will “Never Moon” Won’t Make It: Top XRP Validator
item.description: An XRPL validator has criticized recurring claims that XRP is “dead” or will never deliver major gains. The narratives frequently circulate within the crypto community during long periods of consolidation that test investors’ patience.Visit Website

item.title: Coinbase CEO Says Bitcoin Is More Decentralized and Independent than Central Banks
item.description: Brian Armstrong, the CEO of Coinbase, didn’t hesitate to correct the French Central Bank governor, Francois Villeroy de Galhau, on his Bitcoin misconception. During the ongoing World Economic Forum, where key global financial leaders discussed tokenization and its future, Armstrong emphasized that Bitcoin remains a decentralized protocol more independent than central banks.Visit Website

item.title: Ripple CEO Cleverly Shows XRP in His RLUSD Listing Message
item.description: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse subtly references XRP in reaction to Binance’s official listing of the company’s stablecoin RLUSD. Garlinghouse’s remarks follow reports that RLUSD will commence trading on Binance on January 22, 2025.Visit Website

item.title: Pressure Builds on Bitcoin as Binance Derivatives and Whale Activity Turn Bearish
item.description: Bitcoin has remained under sustained pressure after failing to hold its early-year rally, as spot and derivatives data point to increased selloffs. Bitcoin (BTC) started the year strong, climbing to $97,900 by Jan.Visit Website

item.title: Bitcoin Pullbacks Tied to Rising Global Risk, Not Crypto Weakness: XWIN Research
item.description: The ongoing Bitcoin pullbacks may be less about crypto-specific weakness and more about rising global economic risk. This view was shared in new research from Japan-based XWIN Research.Visit Website
